title: NHTSA Vehicle Safety APIs (recalls, complaints, NCAP ratings, vPIC)
agency: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (U.S. Department of Transportation)
questions: complaints about a vehicle model by component
crash test star ratings for a car
car seat inspection stations in a state
which models of a make have recalls

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser (each returns JSON; save it under the name shown) and upload the files. Without the links: recalls and complaints are searchable at https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls (enter make, model, year), ratings at https://www.nhtsa.gov/ratings, VIN decoding at https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/decoder/; bulk flat files of all recalls and complaints are at https://www.nhtsa.gov/nhtsa-datasets-and-apis (Flat files).

cache.why: Small queries; recalls and complaints are added daily, so data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: NHTSA data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); DOT asks for attribution and no implied endorsement.

citation: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, {dataset}, api.nhtsa.gov / vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which exact model name and model years? Recalls and complaints are looked up per make + model + model year; a range needs one request per year.
Complaints are unverified owner reports, not defect findings: count them as reports, and do not compare raw counts across models without sales or fleet size.
